objects.label: Ascensor mecánico
objects.notes: Translate the complete object in world space. The platform collision top is y=230.

objects.label: Ventilador horizontal
objects.notes: Blades rotate behind the casing. Wind exits to the right.

objects.label: Lava modular
objects.notes: Tile on a 256 px grid. Surface line y=80. Full body tile repeats in both axes. Top body and surface repeat horizontally. Material tiles intentionally fill their rectangular canvas; water has translucent fill.

objects.label: Agua profunda
objects.notes: Tile on a 256 px grid. Surface line y=80. Full body tile repeats in both axes. Top body and surface repeat horizontally. Material tiles intentionally fill their rectangular canvas; water has translucent fill.

objects.label: Túnel de viento
objects.notes: Wind direction left to right; no gameplay geometry.

objects.label: Caldera elemental
objects.notes: Steam emitter [256,204]. Heat is a separate additive-ready layer.

objects.label: Puente retráctil
objects.notes: Collision deck extends from x=176 to x=984 at y=290. Clip to the revealed width; housing is drawn last.

objects.label: Puerta temporizada
objects.notes: Opening collider [174,155,167,288]. Gate is clipped at the lintel; hidden gate pixels are not discarded source art.

objects.label: Planta regable
objects.notes: Six drawn growth stages. Fully grown leaves provide three optional one-way steps; see collider hints.

objects.label: Bloque flotante
objects.notes: Visual buoyancy only. Physics and world translation remain game-controlled.

objects.label: Plataforma de rebote
objects.notes: Top collider follows the moving plate. Spring lengths vary while their lower endpoints stay fixed.

animations.note: 45 degrees per frame at 12 FPS; 3 blades avoid identical 90-degree samples. Starting ends at 205 degrees, loop starts at 270. Stop at the end of the loop cycle.
Overlay while open, before closing. Game code controls timer.
Frames 1 and 8 intentionally match idle so the one-shot settles exactly.
